254:t_005:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Only about a third of us are here, though.」

254:t_005:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes...! We're both alive and kicking!」

254:t_005:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is even livelier than usual.」

254:t_005:5.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Maybe something happened inside that cramped $$ジェニオン$$ cockpit.」

254:t_005:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You should ask $$いぶき$$ about that kind of thing.」

254:t_005:9.en:
$$赤木$$
「Now, now, $$いぶき$$. We've found $n and Miss $$スズネ$$. Let's celebrate.」

254:t_005:11.en:
$$青山$$
「Don't they? They're a carefree bunch, even after being thrown somewhere in space.」

254:t_005:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「First, let's confirm Miss $$スズネ$$ is safe.」

254:t_006:1.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$竜馬$$... You're kind to Miss $$スズネ$$.」

254:t_006:2.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「It looks a little like special treatment.」

254:t_006:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What are you talking about...! I'm doing this as a coworker...」

254:t_006:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But $$竜馬$$... You already quit your job as $$陣代高校$$'s janitor, didn't you?」

254:t_006:6.en:
$$葵$$
「That was a nice comeback, $$正太郎$$!」

254:t_006:7.en:
$$くらら$$
「Now... How will he turn this around?」

254:t_006:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「So Big Bro $$竜馬$$ is playing sexy favorites!」

254:t_006:10.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're playing favorites! You're playing favorites!」

254:t_006:12.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're playing favorites! You're playing favorites!」

254:t_006:15.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But I... am an elementary-school kid.」

254:t_006:17.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Even the fearsome $$流竜馬$$ keeps falling flat.」

254:t_006:18.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Is it all right to fool around like this...?」

254:t_006:19.en:
$n
「That's enough of this. $$サイデリアル$$ is still here.」

254:t_006:21.en:
$$さやか$$
「That's surprising... Knowing $n, I thought he'd get upset if $$竜馬$$ got close to Miss $$スズネ$$.」

254:t_006:22.en:
$$ボス$$
「He must have grown up, too.」

254:t_006:23.en:
$n
「$$竜馬$$ isn't the only one who's left $$陣代高校$$.」

254:t_007:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You'll pay for teasing an adult! I'll give you a good thrashing later!」

254:t_007:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... I'll cover you. Don't go dying on me!」

254:t_007:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh! It's a friendship across generations, forged through fists!」

254:t_007:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Friendship blossoms between two men fighting over a beautiful teacher... That fires me up...!」

254:t_007:6.en:
$n
「Whatever you say to those two, it's pointless...」

254:t_007:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「Everyone...! $$サイデリアル$$ is still here! Don't let your guard down!」

254:t_007:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks, $$タケル$$. Without you, this would've kept dragging on.」

254:t_007:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, intercept $$サイデリアル$$ and...」

254:t_007:10.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Before that, take evasive action immediately.」

254:t_009:1.en:
$$葵$$
「I never thought we'd meet again here...!」

254:t_009:2.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The $$インベーダー#robot$$s are believed to have originally come to Earth from outer space.」

254:t_009:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So this time, we may have entered their habitat.」

254:t_009:4.en:
$$田中司令$$
「In other words, we're the intruders... the invaders, as it were.」

254:t_009:5.en:
$$ギミー$$
「This is no time for stupid jokes, $$田中$$!」

254:t_009:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「That giant one... It's as gross as the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

254:t_009:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We'll just deal with anything that threatens us. Right, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$?」

254:t_009:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Of course. Wherever we are, we're not here to become their food.」

254:t_009:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「I understand! I'll beat them at their own game!」

254:t_009:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Too bad, $$インベーダー#robot$$s! Us getting transported here means your luck has run out!」

254:t_009:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go! Since fate brought us together in this vast universe, I'll fight you until one of us drops dead!」

254:t_010:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Is this all you've got, $$インベーダー#robot$$s?! Don't make me laugh!」

254:t_010:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$竜馬$$ is even more fired up than usual.」

254:t_010:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Maybe he's really trying to impress Miss $$スズネ$$.」

254:t_010:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「No... That's not it... He senses an enemy.」

254:t_010:4.en:
$$柿小路$$
「W-what do you mean, he senses an enemy?!」

254:t_010:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Are you saying reinforcements are coming?!」

254:t_011:0.en:
$$ナオト$$
「There you are, $$インベーダー#robot$$s!」

254:t_011:1.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「There are giant ones, too, but not that many! We should be able to handle them!」

254:t_011:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No...! These are just small fry...!」
